fields.reason: The paper explicitly compares a system grounded in retrieved passages with a model answering from its own parameters (without retrieval) on the same benchmark.

selector.exact: The model that answers from its own parameters answers each question from what it learned in pre-training, without access to any documents. The system grounded in retrieved passages first searches the reference collection and then writes an answer from the passages it found.
